alt: This HHS OIG hotline complaint portal page describes how to submit unclassified complaints online about fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare, Medicaid, and other HHS programs, and provides Spanish-language information.
summary: This HHS OIG hotline complaint portal page describes how to submit unclassified complaints online about fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare, Medicaid, and other HHS programs, and provides Spanish-language information.
full_text: The page explains that users may submit complaints about fraud, waste, and abuse in Medicare, Medicaid, and other HHS programs. A red button labeled 'Submit Your Complaint Now' is shown. A blue box notes that only unclassified complaints may be submitted online. A Spanish-language section provides the same information and advises calling 911 for emergencies.
